text:
sasha: Starting geo rollout for v2.4.1 — US -> EU -> APAC. Locking pins and capacity checks. Deploying at 18:00 PT. pinging ops for warmup/eviction review.
axel: Noted. Can we add a pre-warm pass in US to prime KV cache? Suggest 10% traffic over 20m.
sasha: Yes, plan: US canary 10% 20m -> increase to 40% 30m -> full. EU/APAC frozen until metrics green.
deploy-bot: rollcontrol started: release=v2.4.1 stage=us canary=10%
linda: Autoscaler policy change: bump max replica to 120 for US during rollout window. Confirmed with infra.
anita: Will monitor p95 latency, GPU mem spill, and pod evictions. Alert if node-eviction > 0 or p95 > 250ms for 5m.
axel: What's our rollback trigger? We had noisy OOMs last time.
sasha: Rollback if: node-eviction > 2 in 10m OR request_error_rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 > 400ms sustained 3m. Also manual rollback if core model hallucinations > threshold in eval checks.
mike: Add note: APAC coldstart risk — schedule warmup job `infra/warmup-scripts/kv-priming --region=apac --concurrency=50 --duration=15m` after EU passes.
deploy-bot: canary health update: 18:10 PT - p95=120ms, errors=0.12%, node-evictions=0
linda: Throttling window: we'll enable slice-throttle at 60k tok/s cluster-wide if latency climbs. Ops will handoff to on-call if any threshold crosses.
anita: I'll watch traces. Also enabling cache prefetch for top-50 prompts to reduce tail latency.
sasha: :thumbsup: If all green at 18:40 PT we'll proceed EU canary. Documenting pins: model=v2-quant, routing=us-primary,europe-secondary. saving rollout notes to #release-notes.
deploy-bot: scheduled EU canary @ 19:00 PT. rollcontrol updated.
axel: Quick ask: can we pin older model fallback for EU in case of saturation? `fallback_model=v2-8bit`
sasha: Yes pinned. Also adding graceful degradation policy: route 15% traffic to fallback under surge.
deploy-bot: EU canary started 19:00 PT - canary=5%
mike: If EU passes, APAC planned 02:00 PT (overnight) due to peak hours. Ops please confirm coverage for that window.
linda: Confirmed on-call for APAC window. We'll run slow rollout with 5% -> 20% steps and a 40m steady-state check.
anita: Flagging metric to watch: sustained KV cache miss rate >12% triggers re-eval. Will set alert.
sasha: Thanks everyone. I'll update the runbook and tag #eng-sre for final signoffs. Closing thread once APAC warmup job scheduled.
deploy-bot: thread closed by sasha
